name: envelope-quota-continuation

protocol.note: ADR-039. envelope_task_quota is a per-submit cap, distinct from TaskGraphBuilder::set_quota (ADR-010, build-time only). Large static quota publishes the full deterministic_order in one submit with envelope_overflow unset. Small quota (1) over a 3-task chain: first submit publishes the prefix, records EnvelopeOverflow Deferred with overflow_task_count=2 and continuation_token!=0 (HostAssisted host split). Second submit copies that record onto plan.pending_overflow and publishes leftover only. A second submit without the token must not drain leftover. A Rejected pending record is a refuse and never answers continued(). Firmware DelegatedEnvelope is out of scope; HostAssisted is the honest classification.

correctness.oracle: reference execute_task_graph deterministic_order; union of first+continuation published_tasks equals the oracle sequence with no duplicates

judgement: First-stage portable continuation is overflow buffer + next submit, host-split on TaskGraph::deterministic_order and classified HostAssisted. ADR-010 set_quota remains build-time only. A 3-task chain with quota 1 publishes 1 and defers 2; a missing token does not steal leftover. No DelegatedEnvelope and no firmware envelope extension are claimed. Large-graph continuation cost is unmeasured.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/035/041); comments only, no execution evidence
